lines.text: If your session expires, a message that was waiting to send and your draft are kept for when you sign in again.
Music says when it can't reach your songs, and a reload keeps your place. Repair says when it needs a connection.
Settings asks before throwing away what you typed, and says when a page couldn't load or the phone's storage is full.
Study, Astra and the chat now say what really went wrong: sign-in, a dead link, or today's limit and when it lifts.
